findings.claim: The how-to and ADR 0025 say that after a kmctl release with no template change, `uvx copier update` changes nothing. It does change something: copier rewrites `_commit` in .copier-answers.yml to the new tag, so the project gets a one-line diff to commit at every release. That is the cost the operator accepted, so the docs should say so.

The how-to's table still describes the generated .pre-commit-config.yaml as 'Generic hooks only'. It does not mention the new exclude, which leaves the agent files APM and kmctl plugin patch install (.agents/, .claude/agents|rules|skills/, .opencode/, opencode.json) unchecked. A user who adds a hook and sees it skip those files has nothing to explain why.
